description: Tails Suricata's eve.json and files alert events by Suricata's own severity and anomaly events as medium signals; all other event types are ignored.
name: suricata_feed

signals.description: A Suricata signature matched (alert event); severity follows Suricata's: 1 is high, 2 is medium, 3 is info. Episode: signature_id + src + dest.
signals.name: suricata_alert

signals.description: A Suricata decoder or protocol parser anomaly fired; severity is medium, once per distinct anomaly event per cooldown window.
signals.name: suricata_anomaly
